description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pelapitigama, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510214 (23/0909)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
